# PowerPlay v1.3.10 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Prevent Fire TV screensavers from interrupting a PowerLink destination handoff while the receiving app resolves Plex metadata, restores the exact queue, and initializes its video player.
- Hold the destination screen awake with a temporary, bounded lease until playback starts, fails, is cancelled, or times out. Share screen-awake ownership with normal video playback so brief startup buffering does not release it.
- Preserve the existing source-pause-after-destination-confirmation rule, exact shuffled or sequential queue order, playback position, and 1080p/4K matching. No automatic app force-stop or persistent background polling.

## Compatibility

For best results, update the companion [PowerLink HACS integration to v0.2.1](https://github.com/The-Power-0/PowerLink/releases/tag/v0.2.1) so Home Assistant wakes the destination Fire Stick and dismisses its screensaver before opening the incoming handoff. Existing PowerLink pairing and device settings remain compatible. This is a targeted app-startup fix; real-device verification is recommended.
